scientific_scope_status: Delivered P1 constructions acquire a finite simplex-lattice response law for a warranted bounded positive quadratic-form source, including exactly dark or arbitrarily weak couplings. Signed interpolation has dimension-independent noise factor C_k=binom(2k-1,k); the positive Bernstein route has noise gain1 and bias delta^2 kappa G^2/k. Subsequent declared task certificates reuse the same readings.

unavailable_or_unclassified: The binomial node count remains; sparse command support does not make acquisition dimension-free. Fit quality does not prove source physics, stability, control/reset or calibration warrants. Shared calibration error is correlated and is not automatically multiplied by C_k. Equal-information conventional methods can use the same acquisition; no physical device, photon lower bound or practical advantage follows. Historical N1089 code/run remains unacquired; these fresh implementations are not its replay.
